searchText: <@892053833121923094> I am keen to get your input on testing efforts followed by changes proposed here https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/338. Particularly, we would need to remove TTD validation from Hive tests (either for V1 methods or just for V2s -- depending on how implementations do handle V2) and patch `INVALID_BLOCK_HASH` tests. Sounds good, I don’t think it would be a problem, it should only be a matter of making the changes consistent between all clients
